newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden 10.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Sweden 10.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: A Swedish auction of 10.5 billion crowns of Treasury bills was heavily oversubscribed, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of 1.5 billion crowns of three-month T-bills was 4.08 percent, the debt office said.
It received 31 bids worth 6.5 billion crowns of which it accepted one.
The office said the average accepted rate of an auction of 3.0 billion crowns of six-month T-bills was 4.11 percent.
It accepted three bids from a total of 30 which amounted to 5.87 billion crowns.
An auction of 6.0 billion crowns of one-year paper posted an average accepted rate of 4.26 percent.
The office said it accepted 63 bids from a total of 88 totalling 7.86 billion crowns.
